style_block: Warm comic-book illustration, clean ink outlines, soft cel shading, rich saturated colors, friendly cinematic framing, no text, no logos, no watermarks. The person in the reference photo is the main character: keep their face, hair, skin tone and glasses/beard clearly recognizable and flattering, same character in every image. Illustration, not photorealistic. No speech bubbles, no captions, no subtitles, no text anywhere in the image. Vertical 3:4 portrait framing, main character shown head to knees filling the tall frame, scene composed vertically.
outfit: a mustard-yellow jacket over a white t-shirt, dark jeans, white sneakers, a small brown crossbody bag

side_characters.local_woman: a friendly middle-aged woman with short grey hair, wearing a green knitted cardigan over a cream blouse and a dark grey skirt
side_characters.clerk: a friendly female clerk in her 30s with dark hair in a bun, wearing a navy blouse
side_characters.security_guard: a calm security guard wearing a dark navy uniform without any badge text
side_characters.bus_driver: a cheerful bus driver in his 40s with a short beard, wearing a plain dark-blue uniform shirt without any badge text
side_characters.second_woman: a second friendly woman in her 30s with long dark wavy hair, wearing a plain red coat (no yellow, no mustard)
side_characters.queue_man: an elderly man in the queue with white hair, round glasses and a flat cap, wearing a grey sweater and brown trousers
side_characters.older_lady: a kind older lady in her 70s with white curly hair and round glasses, wearing a lilac cardigan and a light grey skirt
side_characters.queue_person_2: a friendly young person in the queue with a blue backpack, wearing a dark green hoodie and black jeans

placeholders.{genero_desc}: "a man" (genero m) or "a woman" (genero f), resolved in code
